items.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes sinks near Ibiza, killing one
items.summary: An oil tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel has sunk off the coast of Ibiza, leaving one crew member dead, authorities have said.

items.title: Netherlands to return two historic Kandyan guns to Sri Lanka
items.summary: The Government of the Netherlands has decided to return two historic 18th-century Sri Lankan firearms, known as Maha Thuwakku (rampart guns), which were taken from the Kingdom of Kandy during the Dutch colonial period.

items.title: New fuel station on Delft Island moves closer to operation
items.summary: Fuel transportation to the newly constructed permanent filling station on Delft Island in Jaffna has been successfully completed.

items.title: Musk’s plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
items.summary: US regulators have given SpaceX the go-ahead to launch a million satellites into Earth’s orbit to help build data centres in space - the first approval of its kind.

items.title: SAARC Cultural Centre in Matara to be handed over to Ocean University

items.title: Third phase of public sector salary hike to take effect in January 2027 – PM
items.summary: Prime Minister and Education Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has assured teacher and principal trade unions that the third phase of the public sector salary increase will be implemented in January 2027.

items.title: Five elephant control units receive Rs. 90 million vehicle boost
